caption: MCP Initialize Result
description: After receiving an initialize request from the client, the server sends this response. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 InitializeResult).
name: mcp_initialize_result

mcp_meta.description: MCP member `_meta`: See [General fields: `_meta`](/specification/2025-11-25/basic/index#meta) for notes on `_meta` usage.

mcp_instructions.description:
MCP member `instructions`: Instructions describing how to use the server and its features.

This can be used by clients to improve the LLM's understanding of available tools, resources, etc. It can be thought of like a "hint" to the model. For example, this information MAY be added to the system prompt.

mcp_protocol_version.description: MCP member `protocolVersion` (required by the protocol): The version of the Model Context Protocol that the server wants to use. This may not match the version that the client requested. If the client cannot support this version, it MUST disconnect.

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.
